details: Government conservation account identifies the original south-facing marble niche, surviving arch and elevated pillar platform.
Haidian project statement records the alignment of the five-bay northern pavilion, the fountain, and the southern viewing area, and notes surviving columns on the earthen podium.
The park documents the five returned stone screens and two smaller masonry remnants, and identifies the original complexes and architectural relief.
The site’s 2016 archaeological work was concentrated around the Great Fountain and Yuanyingguan.
